name: barbershop
description: Barber shop boilerplate: Fastify + MongoDB API, React + MUI admin panel and landing page, Expo React Native app

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api -w apps/admin -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api -w apps/admin -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api -w apps/admin -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api -w apps/admin -w apps/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/admin -w apps/web
